identity.title: [v0.92.1][GCP-D1] Deploy the bounded private foundation and prove non-GPU workload disposal

values.summary: Execute the smallest proving validation DAG.

lanes.proof_role: Prove #731 typed bootstrap files, design authorization gate, exact tfvars authority, and static infra/gcp/platform private-foundation denominator before bind without live GCP mutation.

Create and inspect a saved Terraform plan for infra/gcp/platform proving exactly the accepted foundation denominator and rejecting public IP/route, public ingress, broad IAM, replacement, or extra resources before apply.
lanes.defer_reason: Deferred until #731 is bound and exact Terraform/backend inputs are confirmed.

lanes.proof_role: Read-only GCP proof for exact project, region, required APIs, quota, billing, IAM, remote state, and short-lived impersonation readiness without secret exposure.
lanes.defer_reason: Requires approved local GCP credential context but performs no mutation.

lanes.proof_role: Generate the fresh operator authorization packet containing exact project, region, zone, plan digest, network/subnet, run ID, instance name, cleanup deadline, impersonated identity, rollback commands, and cost caps before any apply/run.
lanes.defer_reason: Must run after saved plan digest and run identity are generated.

lanes.proof_role: After explicit operator authorization only, apply the bounded foundation and prove private foundation, separate identities, five storage-owner boundaries, labels, and watchdog metric by redacted live readback.
lanes.defer_reason: Requires fresh explicit operator authorization for live GCP mutation and spend.

lanes.proof_role: After explicit operator authorization only, run exactly one labelled e2-micro private VM, prove RUNNING without external IP and readiness, destroy it and its boot disk within the window, and prove zero residue by independent readback.
lanes.defer_reason: Requires fresh explicit operator authorization for live GCP mutation and spend.

lanes.proof_role: Reject whitespace and patch hygiene defects in the exact issue range and current worktree before design approval and bind.
Fail closed until completed implementation evidence and SOR/SRP truth are ready for exact-head independent review before publication.
lanes.defer_reason: Deferred until implementation and evidence are complete.

values.failure_policy: Fail closed on missing or stale typed state, failed dependency/preflight, absent authorization, over-budget estimate, denominator drift, credential exposure, public network exposure, disposable residue, expired deadline, failed review, or failed required CI.
